skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Prairie Pals
skins.content: 0011 New Arrivals/Prairie Pals. Outfit Bena wore on a field mission in the prairie. The traditional clothes serving as the base have been enhanced with modern innovations, making them lightweight without sacrificing cuteness.
skins.quote: Bena dreamed. In the dream, the master of a super-big steamer basket told her that as long as she was willing to help, she could have some real yummy xiaolongbao. And so, Bena picked up her rod, sat down on a Beast Steward, and... started running errands!
